## Multinomial Regression

### Gradient Descent With a Fixed Learning Rate

```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Prepare the data
data <- lag_data %>%
  dplyr::select(-date, -nasdaq_prch) %>%
  drop_na()

TT <- 1000
train_data <- data[1:TT, ]
test_data <- data[(TT + 1):nrow(data), ]
```

Guess the learning rate of the training data

```{r}
X <- as.matrix(train_data[, -ncol(train_data)])  

# Calculate X'X
XTX <- t(X) %*% X

# Compute the maximum eigenvalue of X'X
eigen_values <- eigen(XTX, only.values = TRUE)$values
lambda_max <- max(eigen_values)

# Estimate Lipschitz constant
num_classes <- length(unique(train_data$nasdaq_cat))  
L <- (1 / 4) * lambda_max

1/L
```

```{r}
# Define the logistic sigmoid function
sigmoid <- function(z) {
  return(1 / (1 + exp(-z)))
}

# Log likelihood function
log_likelihood <- function(pred, y) {
  return(-sum(y * log(pred) + (1 - y) * log(1 - pred)) / length(pred))
}

# Gradient descent with a fixed learning rate for logistic regression
gd_fixed_eta <- function(X, y, eta, max_iter, tol = 1e-10) {
  n_samples <- nrow(X)
  n_features <- ncol(X)
  
  w <- matrix(0, nrow = n_features, ncol = 1)  # Adjusted for binary classification
  loss_hist <- numeric(max_iter)
  error <- numeric(max_iter)
  
  timer_start <- proc.time()  # Start the timer

  for (iter in 1:max_iter) {
    logits <- X %*% w
    prob <- sigmoid(logits)
    
    loss_hist[iter] <- log_likelihood(prob, y)
    pred <- ifelse(prob > 0.5, 1, 0)
    error[iter] <- mean(pred != y)
    
    if (iter > 1 && abs(loss_hist[iter - 1] - loss_hist[iter]) < tol) {
      time_elapsed <- proc.time() - timer_start  # Calculate elapsed time
      cat(sprintf("Algorithm converged after %d iterations. Time elapsed: %f seconds. Loss: %f, Training Error: %f\n", iter, as.numeric(time_elapsed["elapsed"]), loss_hist[iter], error[iter]))
      break
    }
    
    # Gradient calculation for logistic regression
    grad <- t(X) %*% (prob - y) / n_samples
    w <- w - eta * grad
    
    # If maximum iteration reached without convergence
    if (iter == max_iter) {
      time_elapsed <- proc.time() - timer_start  # Calculate elapsed time
      cat(sprintf("Maximum iterations (%d) reached without convergence. Time elapsed: %f seconds. Last Loss: %f, Last Training Error: %f\n",max_iter, as.numeric(time_elapsed["elapsed"]), loss_hist[iter], error[iter]))
    }
  }
  
  return(list(w = w, loss_hist = loss_hist[1:iter], error = error[1:iter], convg_iter = iter))
}
```


```{r}
# Testing different learning rates
etas <- 1/L

results_gd_fix <- list()
for (rate in etas) {
  model_gd_fix <- gd_fixed_eta(as.matrix(train_data[-ncol(train_data)]), 
                        train_data$nasdaq_cat, 
                        rate, max_iter = 1e5, tol = 1e-8)
  
  results_gd_fix[[as.character(rate)]] <- model_gd_fix
}
```

```{r}
# Plotting results
plot_data_gd_fix <- data.frame()
for (rate in names(results_gd_fix)) {
  iterations <- seq_along(results_gd_fix[[rate]]$loss_hist)
  plot_data_gd_fix <- rbind(plot_data_gd_fix, data.frame(Iter = iterations, Loss = results_gd_fix[[rate]]$loss_hist,
                                           Rate = as.factor(as.numeric(rate)), Error = results_gd_fix[[rate]]$error))
}

# Loss by iteration for each learning rate
ggplot(plot_data_gd_fix, aes(x = Iter, y = Loss, color = Rate)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Loss by Iteration for Different Learning Rates", x = "Iteration", y = "Loss")

# Error by iteration for each learning rate
ggplot(plot_data_gd_fix, aes(x = Iter, y = Error, color = Rate)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Training Error by Iteration for Different Learning Rates", x = "Iteration", y = "Error")
```

```{r}
# Calculate testing error for each learning rate
test_errors <- numeric(length(etas))
names(test_errors) <- as.character(etas)

for (rate in etas) {
  w <- results_gd_fix[[as.character(rate)]]$w  # Get the weights for the model
  logits_test <- as.matrix(test_data[-ncol(test_data)]) %*% w
  probs_test <- sigmoid(logits_test)
  predictions_test <- ifelse(probs_test > 0.5, 1, 0)
  test_errors[as.character(rate)] <- mean(predictions_test != test_data$nasdaq_cat)
}

# Print out the testing errors for each learning rate
print(test_errors)
```


### Accelerated Gradient Descent

```{r}
# Accelerated Gradient Descent for logistic regression
accelerated_gd <- function(X, y, L_f, max_iter, tol = 1e-8) {
  n_samples <- nrow(X)
  n_features <- ncol(X)
  
  w <- matrix(0, nrow = n_features, ncol = 1)  # Adjusted for binary classification
  y_t <- w  # Initialize y_t to w
  tau_t <- 1
  loss_hist <- numeric(max_iter)
  error <- numeric(max_iter)
  
  timer_start <- proc.time()  # Start the timer

  for (iter in 1:max_iter) {
    logits <- X %*% y_t
    prob <- sigmoid(logits)
    
    loss_hist[iter] <- log_likelihood(prob, y)
    pred <- ifelse(prob > 0.5, 1, 0)
    error[iter] <- mean(pred != y)
    
    grad <- t(X) %*% (prob - y) / n_samples
    x_next <- y_t - (1 / L_f) * grad
    
    if (iter > 1 && abs(loss_hist[iter - 1] - loss_hist[iter]) < tol) {
      time_elapsed <- proc.time() - timer_start  # Calculate elapsed time
      cat(sprintf("Algorithm converged after %d iterations. Time elapsed: %f seconds. Loss: %f, Training Error: %f\n", iter, as.numeric(time_elapsed["elapsed"]), loss_hist[iter], error[iter]))
      break
    }
    
    tau_next <- (1 + sqrt(4 * tau_t^2 + 1)) / 2
    y_t <- x_next + ((tau_t - 1) / tau_next) * (x_next - w)
    
    w <- x_next
    tau_t <- tau_next
    
    # If maximum iteration reached without convergence
    if (iter == max_iter) {
      time_elapsed <- proc.time() - timer_start  # Calculate elapsed time
      cat(sprintf("Maximum iterations (%d) reached without convergence. Time elapsed: %f seconds. Last Loss: %f, Last Training Error: %f\n",max_iter, as.numeric(time_elapsed["elapsed"]), loss_hist[iter], error[iter]))
    }
  }
  
  return(list(w = w, loss_hist = loss_hist[1:iter], error = error[1:iter], convg_iter = iter))
}

# Example usage with L_f as a placeholder for Lipschitz constant
model_acd <- accelerated_gd(as.matrix(train_data[-ncol(train_data)]), 
                        train_data$nasdaq_cat, 
                        L_f = L, max_iter = 1e5, tol = 1e-8)
```

```{r}
# Plot Error by iteration
ggplot(plot_data_acd, aes(x = Iter, y = Error)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Training Error by Iteration for Accelerated Gradient Descent", x = "Iteration", y = "Error")
```

### Accelerated Gradient Descent with Backtracking Linesearch

```{r}
# Accelerated Gradient Descent with backtracking line search for logistic regression
accelerated_gd_backtracking <- function(X, y, eta, max_iter, tol = 1e-8, beta) {
  n_samples <- nrow(X)
  n_features <- ncol(X)
  
  w <- matrix(0, nrow = n_features, ncol = 1)  # Initialize weights
  y_t <- w  # Initialize y_t to w
  tau_t <- 1
  loss_hist <- numeric(max_iter)
  error <- numeric(max_iter)
  eta_hist <- numeric(max_iter)  # To store eta values over iterations
  eta <- eta  # Initial learning rate
  
  timer_start <- proc.time()  # Start the timer

  for (iter in 1:max_iter) {
    logits <- X %*% y_t
    prob <- sigmoid(logits)
    current_loss <- log_likelihood(prob, y)
    
    # Store eta value
    eta_hist[iter] <- eta
    
    if (iter > 1 && current_loss >= loss_hist[iter - 1] && eta > 1e-10) {
      eta <- eta * beta 
    }

    loss_hist[iter] <- current_loss
    pred <- ifelse(prob > 0.5, 1, 0)
    error[iter] <- mean(pred != y)
    
    grad <- t(X) %*% (prob - y) / n_samples
    x_next <- y_t - eta * grad
    
    if (iter > 1 && abs(loss_hist[iter - 1] - loss_hist[iter]) < tol) {
      time_elapsed <- proc.time() - timer_start  # Calculate elapsed time
      cat(sprintf("Algorithm converged after %d iterations. Time elapsed: %f seconds. Loss: %f, Training Error: %f, Final Eta: %f\n", iter, as.numeric(time_elapsed["elapsed"]), loss_hist[iter], error[iter], eta_hist[iter]))
      break
    }
    
    tau_next <- (1 + sqrt(4 * tau_t^2 + 1)) / 2
    y_t <- x_next + ((tau_t - 1) / tau_next) * (x_next - w)
    
    w <- x_next
    tau_t <- tau_next
    
    # If maximum iteration reached without convergence
    if (iter == max_iter) {
      time_elapsed <- proc.time() - timer_start  # Calculate elapsed time
      cat(sprintf("Maximum iterations (%d) reached without convergence. Time elapsed: %f seconds. Last Loss: %f, Last Training Error: %f, Final Eta: %f\n", max_iter, as.numeric(time_elapsed["elapsed"]), loss_hist[iter], error[iter], eta_hist[iter]))
    }
  }
  
  return(list(w = w, loss_hist = loss_hist[1:iter], error = error[1:iter], eta_hist = eta_hist[1:iter], convg_iter = iter))
}

# Example usage with L_f as a placeholder for Lipschitz constant
model_backtracking <- accelerated_gd_backtracking(as.matrix(train_data[-ncol(train_data)]), 
                                                  train_data$nasdaq_cat, 
                                                  eta = 100, max_iter = 1e5, tol = 1e-8, beta = 0.95)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
plot_data_backtrack <- data.frame(

  Loss = model_backtracking$loss_hist,
  Error = model_backtracking$error,
  Eta = model_backtracking$eta_hist
)

# Plot Loss by iteration

  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Loss by Iteration", x = "Iteration", y = "Loss")

# Plot Error by iteration

# Plot Eta by iteration

  labs(title = "Learning Rate (\u03B7) by Iteration", x = "Iteration", y = "Learning Rate")+
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1000))

# Calculate the testing error

logits_test <- as.matrix(test_data[-ncol(test_data)]) %*% w
probs_test <- sigmoid(logits_test)
predictions_test <- ifelse(probs_test > 0.5, 1, 0)
test_error <- mean(predictions_test != test_data$nasdaq_cat)

# Print out the testing error
print(paste("Testing Error:", test_error))
```

### Stochastic Gradient Descent with Mini-Batch

```{r}
# Mini-Batch Stochastic Gradient Descent with Backtracking Line Search for Logistic Regression
mini_batch_sgd_backtrack <- function(X, y, batch_size, eta, beta, max_iter, tol = 1e-8) {
  n_samples <- nrow(X)
  n_features <- ncol(X)
  
  w <- matrix(0, nrow = n_features, ncol = 1)  # Initialize weights
  loss_hist <- numeric(max_iter)
  error <- numeric(max_iter)
  eta_hist <- numeric(max_iter)  # To store eta values over iterations
  
  timer_start <- proc.time()  # Start the timer

  for (iter in 1:max_iter) {
    # Sample a mini-batch
    set.seed(66666)
    idx <- sample(1:n_samples, batch_size, replace = T)
    X_batch <- X[idx,  ]
    y_batch <- y[idx]
    
    logits <- X_batch %*% w
    prob <- sigmoid(logits)
    current_loss <- log_likelihood(prob, y_batch)
    
    # Store eta value
    eta_hist[iter] <- eta
    
    if (iter > 1 && current_loss >= loss_hist[iter - 1] && eta > 1e-9) {
      eta <- eta * beta  # Reduce eta if the current loss is not lower than the previous loss
    }
    
    loss_hist[iter] <- current_loss
    pred <- ifelse(prob > 0.5, 1, 0)
    error[iter] <- mean(pred != y_batch)
    
    # Gradient calculation for logistic regression on the mini-batch
    grad <- t(X_batch) %*% (prob - y_batch) / batch_size
    w <- w - eta * grad
    
    if (iter > 1 && abs(loss_hist[iter - 1] - loss_hist[iter]) < tol) {
      time_elapsed <- proc.time() - timer_start  # Calculate elapsed time
      cat(sprintf("Algorithm converged after %d iterations. Time elapsed: %f seconds. Loss: %f, Training Error: %f, Final Eta: %f\n",
                  iter, as.numeric(time_elapsed["elapsed"]), loss_hist[iter], error[iter], eta_hist[iter]))
      break
    }
    
    # If maximum iteration reached without convergence
    if (iter == max_iter) {
      time_elapsed <- proc.time() - timer_start  # Calculate elapsed time
      cat(sprintf("Maximum iterations (%d) reached without convergence. Time elapsed: %f seconds. Last Loss: %f, Last Training Error: %f, Final Eta: %f\n",
                  max_iter, as.numeric(time_elapsed["elapsed"]), loss_hist[iter], error[iter], eta_hist[iter]))
    }
  }
  
  return(list(w = w, loss_hist = loss_hist[1:iter], error = error[1:iter], eta_hist = eta_hist[1:iter], convg_iter = iter))
}
```


```{r}
# Parameters
TT <- nrow(train_data)
batch_sizes <- round(TT * c(0.3, 0.4, 0.5), 0)
eta_start <- 1/L
max_iter <- 1e5
beta <- 0.95

# Data structure to store results
results_sgd_back <- list()

# Run model for each batch size and store results
for (batch_size in batch_sizes) {
  results_sgd_back[[as.character(batch_size)]] <- mini_batch_sgd_backtrack(
    as.matrix(train_data[-ncol(train_data)]), 
    train_data$nasdaq_cat, 
    batch_size, eta_start, beta, max_iter, tol = 1e-8
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Plot results and calculate testing error
plot_data_sgd_back <- data.frame()
test_errors <- setNames(numeric(length(batch_sizes)), batch_sizes)

for (batch_size in names(results_sgd_back)) {
  iterations <- seq_along(results_sgd_back[[batch_size]]$loss_hist)
  plot_data_sgd_back <- rbind(plot_data_sgd_back, data.frame(Iter = iterations, Loss = results_sgd_back[[batch_size]]$loss_hist,
                                           Error = results_sgd_back[[batch_size]]$error, Eta = results_sgd_back[[batch_size]]$eta_hist,
                                           BatchSize = as.factor(batch_size)))
  
  # Calculate testing error
  w <- results_sgd_back[[batch_size]]$w
  logits_test <- as.matrix(test_data[-ncol(test_data)]) %*% w
  probs_test <- sigmoid(logits_test)
  predictions_test <- ifelse(probs_test > 0.5, 1, 0)
  test_errors[batch_size] <- mean(predictions_test != test_data$nasdaq_cat)
}
```


```{r}
ggplot(plot_data_sgd_back, aes(x = Iter)) +

# Print testing errors
```

### AdapGrad + Mini-batch

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Define the mini-batch SGD with AdaGrad and backtracking line search for logistic regression
mini_batch_sgd_adagrad_backtrack <- function(X, y, batch_size, eta, beta, max_iter, epsilon = 1e-8, tol = 1e-8) {
  n_samples <- nrow(X)
  n_features <- ncol(X)
  
  w <- matrix(0, nrow = n_features, ncol = 1)  # Initialize weights
  v <- matrix(0, nrow = n_features, ncol = 1)  # Initialize sum of squares of gradients
  
  loss_hist <- numeric(max_iter)
  error <- numeric(max_iter)
  eta_hist <- numeric(max_iter)
  
  timer_start <- proc.time()  # Start the timer
  
  for (iter in 1:max_iter) {
    # Sample a mini-batch
    set.seed(66666)
    idx <- sample(1:n_samples, batch_size, replace = T)
    X_batch <- X[idx,  ]
    y_batch <- y[idx]
    
    logits <- X_batch %*% w
    prob <- sigmoid(logits)
    current_loss <- log_likelihood(prob, y_batch)
    
    loss_hist[iter] <- current_loss
    pred <- ifelse(prob > 0.5, 1, 0)
    error[iter] <- mean(pred != y_batch)
    
    # Store eta value
    eta_hist[iter] <- eta
    
    if (iter > 1 && current_loss >= loss_hist[iter - 1] && eta > 1e-9) {
      eta <- eta * beta  # Reduce eta if the current loss is not lower than the previous loss
    }
    
    # Compute gradients for the mini-batch
    grad <- t(X_batch) %*% (prob - y_batch) / batch_size
    
    # Update gradient history
    v <- v + grad^2
    
    # Update weights
    w_adjustment <- (eta / sqrt(v + epsilon)) * grad
    w <- w - w_adjustment
    
    if (iter > 1 && abs(loss_hist[iter - 1] - loss_hist[iter]) < tol) {
      time_elapsed <- proc.time() - timer_start  # Calculate elapsed time
      cat(sprintf("Algorithm converged after %d iterations. Time elapsed: %f seconds. Loss: %f, Training Error: %f, Final Eta: %f\n",
                  iter, as.numeric(time_elapsed["elapsed"]), loss_hist[iter], error[iter], eta_hist[iter]))
      break
    }
    
    if (iter == max_iter) {
      time_elapsed <- proc.time() - timer_start  # Calculate elapsed time
      cat(sprintf("Maximum iterations (%d) reached without convergence. Time elapsed: %f seconds. Last Loss: %f, Last Training Error: %f, Final Eta: %f\n",
                  max_iter, as.numeric(time_elapsed["elapsed"]), loss_hist[iter], error[iter], eta_hist[iter]))
    }
  }
  
  return(list(w = w, loss_hist = loss_hist[1:iter], error = error[1:iter], eta_hist = eta_hist[1:iter], convg_iter = iter))
}
```


```{r}
# Parameters
TT <- nrow(train_data)
batch_sizes <- round(TT * c(0.3, 0.4, 0.5), 0)
eta_initial <- 1/L  # Initial learning rate for AdaGrad
beta <- 0.5  # Backtracking line search reduction factor
max_iter <- 1e6
epsilon <- 1e-10

# Run model for each batch size and store results
results_adagrad_backtrack <- list()
for (batch_size in batch_sizes) {
  cat("Running mini-batch SGD with AdaGrad and backtracking for batch size:", batch_size, "\n")
  results_adagrad_backtrack[[as.character(batch_size)]] <- mini_batch_sgd_adagrad_backtrack(
    as.matrix(train_data[-ncol(train_data)]), 
    train_data$nasdaq_cat,
    batch_size, 
    eta_initial, beta, max_iter, epsilon, tol = 1e-8
  )
}
```


```{r}

    Iter = iterations,
    Loss = results_adagrad_backtrack[[batch_size]]$loss_hist,
    Error = results_adagrad_backtrack[[batch_size]]$error,

  ))

ggplot(plot_data_adagrad_backtrack, aes(x = Iter)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Error, color = BatchSize)) +
  labs(title = "Training Error by Iteration for Different Batch Sizes (AdaGrad with Backtracking)", y = "Error")

ggplot(plot_data_adagrad_backtrack, aes(x = Iter)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Eta, color = BatchSize)) +

}
```
